messages:
Maya P: Morning — nightly SAST spike: ~120 new low/medium findings in `proto-gen` after the upstream protobuf toolchain bump. FWIW most look like generated-serialization dead branches.
Ravi K: Ugh. Is this the frontend or infra repo?
Maya P: infra/proto-libs and infra/ingest-client. Scanner: `sast-runner v2.4.0` attached output snippet: ```proto_gen/serializers.go: line 342: possible nil deref (LOW)
proto_gen/serializers.go: line 412: unreachable code (MEDIUM)
proto_gen/serializers.go: line 99: shadowed variable (LOW)```
Elena S: Those are typical false positives from generated code. Do we already have a rule to skip `proto_gen/` paths?
Maya P: We had a suppression file but it didn't carry over when we split the monorepo -> multi-repo. Looks like the baseline config lives in infra/scan-config/.sast-baseline.yml in monorepo; not present in new repos.
Ravi K: Can we add a repo-level `.sast-ignore` for `proto_gen/**` and import the baseline from central?
Jae H: Quick option: add this to the scanner config for infra/ingest-client: ```ignore_paths: - 'proto_gen/**'``` then re-run nightly. But we should be careful — we don't want to ignore real findings in that dir if code becomes hand-modified.
Elena S: Agreed. Policy-wise we only allow ignore for generated folders that are marked `DO NOT EDIT` with a header. If a file lacks header, scanner should still alert.
Maya P: Most generated files have the header. I can push the ignore and include a validation step that checks for the header.
SecurityBot: Logged incident INC-2026-315 for scan-noise spike; priority: P3; owner: eng-security. https://incident.redwood/in/INC-2026-315
Oncall Bot: Paging eng-oncall: @eng-oncall please triage per runbook.
Ravi K: For the long term: add a pre-commit hook that detects generated files and tags them, and add a pre-merge SAST rule that respects the tag. Also let's add a nightly job that diff-checks new ruleset drift.
Jae H: We should also create a suppression-as-code pattern: a central suppression repo that each repo references by commit hash, so splits won't lose baseline.
Elena S: +1. Also update the security review checklist: "confirm generated files are either auto-ignored or have a REVIEWED header".
Maya P: I'll open two PRs: one repo-level ignore to stop the noisy alerts (temporary), and one infra PR to wire up suppression-as-code and the header validator. Tagging @eng-security in both.
Ravi K: When you open the PR, include a minimal repro and the raw scanner output lines for traceability.
Maya P: Will do. Quick re-run done at 1745551600 — noise down to 6 findings (real ones). Attaching the run link.
Elena S: Can we add the baseline import to the CI gating so future repo splits don't regress?
Jae H: Yup — gating step: `curl https://suppressions.internal/repo/infra/sha | sastctl import-baseline -` and fail if import missing.
Maya P: Added checklist item to incident: export baseline, add header validator, and create suppression repo. Closing incident once PRs merge.
Ravi K: Thanks, team. Nice quick turnaround :thumbsup:
